svg.title: Polka Portals — album / single cover 3000×3000 (PP-TPL-003)
svg.desc: Streaming services require 3000×3000 RGB, no URLs or social handles in the art. Must read at 64 px: keep the title short or drop it. Paper ground (#F6F5F2); for the dark edition swap the paper rect to #151519 and the ink to #FFFFFF. GUIDES are hidden for export.

g.text: CENTREPIECE — place emblem or PP-IMG-ALBUM-001 art
